description:
About the team

The AMER Technical Account Management team looks after Veriff’s key enterprise customers. We make sure they get maximum value from our identity verification platform, from first integration through adoption and long-term growth. Working alongside Account Managers, Solutions Engineers, Product, Engineering and Support, we turn customer needs into clear technical plans and see them through. When something gets stuck, we’re the ones who step in, bring the right people together and get it resolved.

The opportunity

As a Senior Technical Account Manager for AMER, you’ll be the trusted technical advisor to a portfolio of Veriff’s key enterprise customers. You’ll own onboarding and integration projects end to end, clear technical roadblocks, and make sure what we deliver lines up with what each customer needs. Success means smooth implementations, deep technical trust, and Veriff becoming the identity verification partner our customers can’t do without. The role is remote, with a preference for the Bay Area.

What you'll achieve in your first 3 months

  • Own the onboarding and integration projects for your customers, with clear project plans, milestones and deliverables.
  • Act as the bridge between your customers and Veriff’s GTM, Product, Engineering and Support teams, aligning everyone on technical requirements and timelines.
  • Set up a regular rhythm of data-driven status updates and project documentation for customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Proactively manage escalations, risks and dependencies so issues are resolved quickly and trust stays intact.

What you'll achieve by 6 months

  • Drive measurable adoption and technical utilization of Veriff’s solutions across your accounts, supporting long-term retention.
  • Be the advisor your customers turn to for architectural and operational guidance that improves their performance and the value they get from Veriff.
  • Contribute to account growth by making sure Veriff’s technical capabilities support each customer’s expansion and strategic goals.

What you'll bring — essential

  • 6+ years in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support or a related SaaS role.
  • A track record of managing enterprise customers and driving technical adoption in complex environments.
  • Hands-on technical expertise with APIs, integrations and troubleshooting.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical projects and managing stakeholders across Sales, Engineering, Product and Support.
  • The ability to juggle multiple priorities across fast-paced, global customer engagements while keeping projects tied to business outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including explaining technical requirements to non-technical audiences.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math or equivalent experience.

Nice to have

  • Spanish and Portuguese, alongside English.
  • Experience in the identity verification (IDV) industry or in customer-facing technical support.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...
  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary
We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives, and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please take the time to read our Recruitment Privacy Notice, which explains how we collect and process your data for recruitment-related activities in accordance with applicable laws. Please read the information carefully. By submitting the application with the required information, you acknowledge that Veriff processes the information for recruitment purposes. Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process, we may request that you undergo identity verification.
